name: Contact Sheet
description: A contact sheet of film strips with sprocket holes along both edges, every frame a little two-tone landscape with a round sun hanging over its horizon.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-mask: @var(--film); mask: @var(--film); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; right: 6%; top: 22%; bottom: 22%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, @p(var(--color2), var(--color3)) 0 @r(52%, 74%), @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)) 0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @r(14%, 64%); top: @r(25%, 38%); width: 22%; height: 22%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color6), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --film: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 7%, #000 7% 93%, transparent 93%), radial-gradient(26% 3.3% at 50% 14.5%, transparent 100%, #000 100%) 0 0 / 12.5% 100%, radial-gradient(26% 3.3% at 50% 85.5%, transparent 100%, #000 100%) 0 0 / 12.5% 100%; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
